brief.goal: Slim AGENTS.md into a stable startup protocol and route implementation details to their existing canonical documents.

forbidden_actions: runtime code, schema, view, API or business-fact changes
real platform reads, writes, confirmations, creates, retries or OAuth refresh
copying dynamic Case, Job, Plan, account or user state into long-term Markdown
credentials, sensitive URLs or raw platform request/payload/response in tracked files
validation_plan: AGENTS.md contains only startup, routing, truth, architecture invariants, safety and task closure
removed details remain discoverable in their canonical logic, data, lessons or deployment document
all referenced paths exist and project/task JSON parses
sensitive and dynamic-detail scans plus git diff --check pass
stop_conditions: a removed rule lacks a canonical destination
the change would alter runtime behavior or business truth
the change would expose sensitive or dynamic runtime data

validation: jq empty project.state.json and Task Context Manifest
removed dynamic and implementation-detail scan against AGENTS.md
